Provenance of this page
Ontology Specification Draft

Abstract

The Forest Fire Ontology (FFONTO) is designed to integrate multi-modal sensor data for early fire detection. It serves as an extensible framework with 'ForestFire' as the root class, incorporating concepts for visual detection, audio monitoring, and environmental conditions.

Introduction back to ToC

This is a place holder text for the introduction. The introduction should briefly describe the ontology, its motivation, state of the art and goals.
